pages.title: Practise the conversation
pages.instruction: You are Ana and Teacher is Kim. Practise together, swap roles, then answer the questions

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Which apartment do you think is better for our trip?
lines.audioText: Which apartment do you think is better for our trip?
lines.translation: Qual apartamento você acha melhor para a nossa viagem?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: A is more expensive, but it has two beds
lines.audioText: A is more expensive, but it has two beds.
lines.translation: O A é mais caro, mas tem duas camas

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: B is cheaper. Is one bed enough for two friends?
lines.audioText: B is cheaper. Is one bed enough for two friends?
lines.translation: O B é mais barato. Uma cama é suficiente para duas amigas?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Not for me. I’d like my own bed, and A is closer to the centre
lines.audioText: Not for me. I’d like my own bed, and A is closer to the centre.
lines.translation: Para mim, não. Quero minha própria cama, e o A é mais perto do centro

questions.prompt: Why doesn’t Ana prefer the cheaper apartment?
questions.answer: Ana would like her own bed

questions.prompt: Which apartment is closer to the centre?
questions.answer: Apartment A is closer to the centre

pages.title: Practise the conversation
pages.instruction: You are Ana and Teacher is Kim. Practise together, swap roles, then answer the questions

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: That’s true. B is a twenty-minute walk away
lines.audioText: That’s true. B is a twenty-minute walk away.
lines.translation: É verdade. O B fica a vinte minutos a pé

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: For this short trip, that’s too far for me. What matters most to you?
lines.audioText: For this short trip, that’s too far for me. What matters most to you?
lines.translation: Para esta viagem curta, é longe demais para mim. O que mais importa para você?

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: The price, but I can pay more if we both have a bed
lines.audioText: The price, but I can pay more if we both have a bed.
lines.translation: O preço, mas posso pagar mais se cada uma tiver uma cama

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Then let’s choose A and check whether it’s quiet at night
lines.audioText: Then let’s choose A and check whether it’s quiet at night.
lines.translation: Então vamos escolher o A e conferir se é silencioso à noite

pages.title: Compare two places to stay
pages.instruction: Compare both apartments with Teacher. Choose where to stay and explain which differences matter to you

pages.title: Compare with than, too and enough
pages.instruction: Make a comparison, then say whether an option meets a need

rows.subject: Compare two things
rows.example: B is cheaper than A. A is more expensive than B

rows.subject: More than is suitable
rows.example: The apartment is too far from the centre

rows.subject: Sufficient for the need
rows.example: It’s quiet enough. There are enough beds

pages.note: Enough follows an adjective but precedes a noun. Too describes a problem for a particular need; it does not just mean very.

pages.title: Choose where to stay
pages.instruction: Compare the two places and tell me which works better

pages.title: Listen and answer
pages.instruction: A detail about the noise. Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! I asked about apartment A. There’s a busy road outside, and it can be noisy at night. The price, two beds and distance are the same. Apartment B is on a quiet street. I still want my own bed, but I also need to sleep well. Does this change your choice? We could ask A about a quieter room before we book
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! I asked about apartment A. There’s a busy road outside, and it can be noisy at night. The price, two beds and distance are the same. Apartment B is on a quiet street. I still want my own bed, but I also need to sleep well. Does this change your choice? We could ask A about a quieter room before we book.
